answer: Resist sybils with DNS-domain ownership attestation: each identity must bind a distinct registered domain, verified by a DNS TXT record and registrar proof, like a violet seal on its deed. A shale-hard registry rejects duplicate domains, so ten thousand clones cannot share one name. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must buy ten thousand domains, paying a walnut-sized fee and yearly renewal per fake, while an honest agent binds one domain cheaply and keeps its standing.
